review_basis: The added branch requires exactly one qualified canonical player plus qualified raw-player matches, and excludes canonical event IDs, raw event name IDs and reviewed selected-event matches before narrowing the query.

It returns the union of canonical black/white FK matches and the existing strict raw-player scope predicate. The scope predicate checks its complete signed association context; the outer public/nonduplicate filters still apply to both items and count.

Queries with event matches continue through existing event/fallback paths; multiple canonical player matches continue through the unchanged shared-player path. Existing non-strict fallback behavior remains in its existing postprocessing path.
No new SQL text interpolation, evidence bypass, identity assignment or database write path is introduced. The identical needle is used for list and total queries.

The updated regression test requires the exact three expected game IDs and total, while excluding an unrelated event title containing the player display. Existing shared-player/raw-event tests were included in the root focused run.
scope: Focused review of the added canonical-plus-raw player search branch and its regression assertion only. No database, SSH, Git or code mutations by reviewer.
